info.title: Hashtag Web3 static catalogs
info.description: Human website first. Machine-readable data is served as static JSON under /data/ (CDN). No hosted MCP or public REST search API.

200.description: City summaries with slug, country, timezone, estimated monthly USD costs and source reference scores. See /nomad-data-notices.txt for data provenance and attribution.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: A slug from the city index, such as lisbon.

200.description: City details, cost breakdown, monthly climate, connectivity and community links.

Object with cities (city slugs) and rows. Row fields: id, name, category index, latitude, longitude, city index, website, source quality, rating, review count, address. Categories: 0 coliving, 1 hostel, 2 apartment, 3 guesthouse, 4 coworking. Zero rating/review count means unavailable. Imported directory, not live availability; includes OpenStreetMap contributor data.
Array of passport countries with id, name and ISO code.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An id from the passport index, such as india.

200.description: Version 3 object with passport, scope, sources and destinations (name, iso, rule). Rule t: vf visa-free, voa visa on arrival, ev eVisa, eta electronic authorization/registration, vr visa or travel permit required, fm freedom of movement, na entry not permitted, unknown no supported answer. Rule d is source-reported days; zero means unspecified, never unlimited. Optional stay preserves non-day periods. Rule label preserves source wording; a lists alternative entry categories. Rule s references sources (kind, title, urls, checkedAt). Source kind government means a government-source check; reference means an attributed Passport Index retrieval, not independent government verification. Rule n contains conditions; until is the exemption's inclusive expiry date. Government rules take precedence and expired exemptions do not fall back to conflicting references. The snapshot covers 199 passports with 198 foreign destinations each; independent government verification is partial. These are ordinary-passport short-visit references, not work or residence permission.
